claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the UConn men's basketball team.
Dan Hurley led UConn to consecutive NCAA championships in 2023 and 2024.
Dan Hurley was named the 19th head coach of the UConn men's basketball team in 2018.
Geno Auriemma is the head coach of the UConn women's basketball team.
Dan Hurley led UConn to a school-record 37 wins in the 2023-24 season.
Dan Hurley signed a six-year contract extension in July 2024.
Dan Hurley's six-year contract extension is worth $50 million.
Dan Hurley is the son of high school coach Bob Hurley Sr.
Geno Auriemma has led the UConn women's basketball team to a record 11 NCAA national titles.
Geno Auriemma has led the UConn women's basketball team to multiple undefeated seasons.
Geno Auriemma has been the head coach of the UConn women's basketball team for over 35 seasons.
